text: The dentist, dental assistants, and front desk staff have always provided excellent service throughout my orthodontic treatment here. However, today I called to schedule an appointment because my braces chain had come loose and I was experiencing severe tooth pain. I didn't know how many sides of the chain were attached. The staff member's tone was unpleasant, and they hung up before I could finish my question. This might have been due to a high volume of patients or some other reason, which I'm not aware of. I apologize for my lack of knowledge on this matter, as I didn't know the exact number of sides of the chain. I'm not an expert in dentistry, but because I paid the clinic for comprehensive dental services, I haven't researched this further. I would like to suggest that the clinic provide more training for its staff regarding customer service. Employees who lack a passion for customer service have many other career options based on their abilities and aptitudes. I also want to address the staff member who acted substandardly towards patients: your words, tone, and demeanor are damaging the clinic's reputation. Please use your judgment before taking any action that could harm the clinic's image, as the staff who currently provide excellent service will also be affected. I hope the clinic will implement measures to prevent and address such incidents in the future. Thank you very much 🙏☺️ I will be reducing the rating until I receive service of a higher standard again, then I will increase it again 🙇
